title: SWITCH FRAMES SF-2: app footprint per warm hidden terminal, window 100% of the visible frame
why: Lead 10:4xZ: size WarmSetBudget.terminalCostBytes from a measurement on a 2x display at the person's window size; record the scale and window; check that pressure evicts the warm set at once. Gate (lead 12:0xZ): hidden busy terminals must not raise app CPU or wakeups at the new warm-set size.

steps.title: set-up: the window at 100% of the visible frame
open 32 terminal workspaces one by one; footprint and warm set at each count; then pressure
busy gate: app CPU and wakeups with 0, 4, 8, 16, 24 hidden terminals printing 20 lines/s
